thread:
Sam K: quick async check-in — yesterday: finished kernel patch to skip empty microbatches, added metrics for batch-shape distribution. Blockers: KV eviction policy still thrashes under tail workload, seeing cold-start misses. Today: iterate eviction, & run end-to-end p95 suite.

Lee R: nice. patch looked small but I saw the microbatch allocator changes — lgtm overall, just a style nits. flagged in the PR.

Anya P: did you run the batch-shape histogram on the 1h prod sample? curious about sequence-length skew.

Sam K: ran it on a 30m slice, attaching rough numbers: median batch size 6, 90th 18, 99th 44. tail correlates with long-seq chat sessions.

Matt G: rough suggestion: try hybrid eviction (LRU + weighted recency by tokens). I sketched a prototype in my sandbox, can share. Might reduce misses for long sequences.

Sam K: that'd be great — can you drop the sketch here or a gist? also wondering if dynamic kv TTL per-session helps.

Matt G: gist: https://gist.github.com/mg/kv-evict-proto (pseudo). Core idea: weight entries by token_count * recent_access_score, decay factor 0.8 per minute.

Nina O: FYI ops-bot posted a microbench earlier: p95 token gen latency for gpt-6b-quant dropped from 42ms -> 34ms after microbatch allocator change. ops-bot, can you paste the run id? :rocket:

ops-bot: benchmark run id: bench-2026-03-15-19-12. summary: model=gpt-6b-quant, config=batcher=v2, microbatch_skip_empty=true, p50=12.3ms, p95=34.1ms, p99=120.6ms, throughput=220 tok/s per-GPU.

Sam K: nice win on p95. p99 still large — likely KV cold misses. I'll instrument miss reason counters next.

Lee R: small PR ping — I left a comment about a missing null-check in the allocator. once that's in, can we roll the allocator change behind a flag? safer for dedicated.

Sam K: yep will add feature-flag and a config knob: "microbatch.max_empty_skip=2". planning canary tomorrow morning.

Anya P: for the E2E p95 suite, include multi-session fanout cases (5 concurrent sessions with long sequences). I can add scenarios to the harness.

Sam K: thanks — assign me a testcase and i'll run it after lunch.

Matt G: I'll open a follow-up PR with the hybrid-evict impl and a small sim to show hit-rate improvement. expect draft by EOD.

Nina O: reminder — dedicated customers on cluster-3 want the patch scheduled next week. coordinate with infra release window.

Sam K: noted. blocking items: need Matt's sim + my instrumentation to decide default eviction params. otherwise green to proceed.

Lee R: I can help with the canary dashboard and add a perf guard for p99 regressions > 1.2x.

Sam K: awesome, thanks. tagging @Matt G for review nudge. :eyes:

Matt G: on it, will review Sam's PR in the next hour.

ops-bot: deploy-notes: canary flag toggles: microbatch_allocator=v2. monitoring: /dashboards/eng-runtime/microbatch-canary.

Sam K: that's it from me. short, focused day. any urgent asks before I start the runs?

Anya P: nothing urgent. ping me when you have the test outputs.

Nina O: will message infra about the release window. :+1:
